skill.name: baoyu-xhs-images
skill.description: Creates Xiaohongshu and RedNote infographic series from articles or pasted content, with selectable visual styles and information layouts.
skill.summary: Plan and generate Xiaohongshu-style infographic series with reusable style and layout presets.
skill.author: JimLiu

static_findings.snippet: Style × Layout can be freely combined. Example: `--style notion --layout dense` creates an intellect
| `cute` (Default) | Sweet, adorable, girly - classic Xiaohongshu aesthetic |
| `dense` | High information density, knowledge card style (5-8 points) |
When no `--style` is specified, analyze content to select:
| Tech, AI, code, digital, app, tool | `tech` |
When no `--layout` is specified, analyze content structure to select:
| Single quote, one key point, cover | `sparse` |
| 5+ points, summary, cheat sheet, 干货 | `dense` |
| Numbered items, top N, checklist, steps | `list` |
| Process, flow, timeline, steps with order | `flow` |
Save to `xhs-images/` subdirectory in the same folder as the article:
2. If `--style` specified, use that style; otherwise auto-select
3. If `--layout` specified, use that layout; otherwise auto-select per image
**Note**: Layout can vary per image in a series. Cover typically uses `sparse`, content pages use `b
| `sparse` | Single focal point centered, 1-2 text elements, maximum breathing room |
| `balanced` | Title at top, 3-4 points in clear sections, moderate spacing |
| `dense` | Grid or multi-section layout, 5-8 points, compact but organized |
| `list` | Vertical numbered/bulleted list, consistent item spacing, clear hierarchy |
| `comparison` | Two-column split, clear divider, mirrored structure left/right |
| `flow` | Horizontal or vertical flow with arrows, connected nodes/steps |
1. **Cover (Image 1)**: Strong visual impact, core title, attention hook → `sparse` layout
2. **Content (Middle)**: Core points per image, density varies by content → `balanced`/`dense`/`list
| `dense` | Grid or multi-section layout, 5-8 points, compact but organized |

content.value_statement: Turning long content into social image cards is slow and inconsistent. This skill plans Xiaohongshu-style infographic series with styles, layouts, prompts, and output paths.
actual_capabilities: Turns an article path or pasted content into a planned 1-10 image infographic series.
Auto-selects a visual style from nine named presets when no style is specified.
Auto-selects layouts from sparse, balanced, dense, list, comparison, and flow options.
Writes an outline with page roles, filenames, text content, and visual concepts.
Creates per-image prompt files with composition, color, text, layout, and style notes.
Coordinates generation through an available image generation skill after user selection when needed.
limitations: It does not include its own image model; final rendering needs a separate image generation skill.
It depends on source content quality and may require edits for brand accuracy.
It supports only the styles and layouts documented in the skill.
It plans and generates image assets but does not publish posts to Xiaohongshu or RedNote.

use_cases.title: Repurpose Long Articles
use_cases.description: Convert blog posts, newsletters, or notes into short visual card series for social sharing.

use_cases.title: Create Product Education Cards
use_cases.description: Turn product features, comparisons, or launches into clear RedNote-style explainers.

use_cases.title: Package Teaching Material
use_cases.description: Break tutorials, frameworks, or checklists into guided visual lessons with consistent layouts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Series
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Xiaohongshu infographic series from the content below. Choose the best style and layout automatically.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Named Style
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a specific visual tone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Xiaohongshu images from this article. Use the fresh style and choose the best layout for each page.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Comparison Post
prompt_templates.scenario: User has before-and-after or pros-and-cons content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform this product comparison into a five-image RedNote series. Use comparison layouts for the main pages and a sparse ending.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Advanced Knowledge Series
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs a detailed multi-page campaign asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a seven-image knowledge-card series from this report. Use notion style, dense content pages, and sparse cover and ending pages.

output_examples.input: A 1,500-word article about AI productivity workflows.
output_examples.output: A six-image plan with a sparse cover, dense knowledge cards, a flow page, and matching prompt files.

output_examples.input: A skincare routine tutorial with five steps and product notes.
output_examples.output: A fresh style series with a list layout, concise page titles, and image prompts for each routine step.

output_examples.input: A SaaS feature comparison for two customer segments.
output_examples.output: A comparison-focused RedNote series with mirrored sections, clear benefits, and a summary ending card.

best_practices: Provide a clear article or topic and name the target audience before generation.
Review the outline before generating all images, especially titles and claims.
Use one visual style across a series unless deliberate contrast is needed.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private customer data or unreleased campaign details into prompts.
Do not request many dense slides when the topic has only one core idea.
Do not skip reviewing generated text in images before publishing.

faq.question: Does this skill create actual images?
faq.answer: It plans the series and prepares prompts. Image rendering requires an available image generation skill.

faq.question: Which languages does it support?
faq.answer: The skill keeps the output language aligned with the input content language.

faq.question: How many images can it plan?
faq.answer: It plans 1-10 images based on content complexity and the requested format.

faq.question: Can I choose the visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. You can specify styles such as cute, tech, minimal, bold, retro, or notion.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: Article-based work is saved beside the article. Direct input is saved under a dated output folder.

faq.question: Is it only for Xiaohongshu?
faq.answer: It is optimized for Xiaohongshu and RedNote, but the card prompts can support similar social formats.
